Hi Olivia — great to hear the demo helped. Below are three practical paths that map to common procurement realities; I included examples so you can see the math. Connor is cc'd for technical sizing on the addon profiles.

1) Pilot -> Annual commit (recommended if you expect steady growth)
   - Pilot: month-to-month at Hosted Standard; seats billed monthly.
   - If you convert to Annual within 60 days of pilot end: apply a pilot-conversion credit equal to 25% of pilot spend (applied against year 1 invoice).
   - Addons (Realtime Embeddings, Dedup cache) are priced as a per-1k-embedding unit + feature premium: base rate $0.003/1k tokens for embeddings + addon multiplier = 1.35x for Realtime, 1.15x for Dedup.

   Example: 100M embeddings/month -> embeddings cost = (100,000 * $0.003)*1.35 = $405/month for Realtime on top of base.

2) Reserved seats + seat-crediting (best for predictable headcount swaps)
   - You commit to N reserved seats annually. If you move seats between teams, we convert unused reserved seats into a one-time seat credit pool. For Lumify: every unused reserved seat >= 3 months unused -> 0.8 seat-credit applied to next invoice (i.e., 20% retention fee).
   - You can apply seat credits toward addon consumption or toward new seats in the same 12-month commitment window.

   Example: commit 120 seats, 40 unused for >=3 months -> credit pool = 40 * 0.8 = 32 seat-credits to allocate.

3) Flex bundle (monthly with discounted addons)
   - No seat reservation. Addons are billed monthly with a volume tier: >=50M embeddings/month gets a 10% addons discount; >=200M gets 20%.

Discounting / one-time incentives
- Standard annual commit discount = 10% off base subscription for 1yr.
- For customers converting from pilot to annual in the same quarter we can offer an additional one-time credit (sponsor approval) — typical range 5–15% depending on total ARR.

Next steps I suggest:
- I’ll prepare an illustrative quote with: 120-seat reserved option (showing seat-credit math) and a Flex Bundle estimate.
- Ben can propose a commercial concession (if needed) and finalize any contract language.

Attaching a two-tab sample: "Quote Summary" + "Addon Breakdowns". Let me know which scenario you want formalized and I’ll send a signed quote.

Olivia — quick commercial note from my side.

We can structure a one-time commercial concession to accelerate the deal if Lumify signs an annual reserved plan by 2027-06-30:
 - One-time onboarding credit equal to 15% of year-1 committed spend (applied to month 1 invoice).
 - Flexible seat-reallocation: we will honor up to 25% of committed seats as convertible credits (no expiration within the contract year) for the first 6 months of the term. After 6 months, reallocation follows the 0.8-credit rule Stephanie outlined.

This approach keeps your procurement comfortable (you get a clear credit buffer) while allowing Redwood to forecast capacity. If you prefer a smaller upfront credit and a higher discount, we can trade off.

I’ll kick off the internal approval for the 15% onboarding credit once Stephanie confirms which committed seat count you want on the quote.
